WPFTweaksBlockAdobeNet.reason: Licensing bypass and third-party Terms of Service violation. Modifies hosts file with hundreds of domain overrides.

WPFOOSUbutton.reason: Handled as dedicated UI button opening official O&O download web page; automatic third-party binary downloading is disabled for security.

WPFchangedns.reason: Handled as first-class native DNS Provider dropdown control in Tweaks and Toolbox tabs.

WPFAddUltPerf.reason: Handled as first-class native Performance Power Plan dropdown control.

WPFRemoveUltPerf.reason: Handled as first-class native Performance Power Plan dropdown control.

WPFTweaksDisableBitLocker.warning: Disabling BitLocker removes disk encryption and leaves drive data completely unprotected against unauthorized physical access.

WPFTweaksRemoveEdge.warning: Removes Microsoft Edge from the system. Some Windows components, widgets, or web-authentication dialogs may be affected.

WPFTweaksRemoveOneDrive.warning: Completely uninstalls OneDrive and stops file synchronization. Ensure all cloud documents are backed up locally.

WPFTweaksWindowsAI.warning: Removes and disables Windows AI, Recall, and Copilot packages system-wide.

WPFTweaksDisableIPv6.warning: Disables IPv6 on all network adapters. Some modern networks and services requiring IPv6 may lose connectivity.
